<function name="GetHLSpeed" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the current speed of the vehicle in Half-Life Hammer Units (in/s). Same as <page>Entity:GetVelocity</page> + <page>Vector:Length</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The speed of the vehicle</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
